title: Blog & guides: choose the reading structure
question: Read mode: comprehension first. One template for articles (27 posts + 3 guides) and a matching index. The article keeps its takeaways, FAQ, sources, author, share and CTA blocks.

options.label: The Notebook Spread
options.lineage: a page of the pad, annotated while reading
options.thesis: The article is the ruled page; the takeaways, sources and CTA live in the margin as pen notes and pinned slips.
options.viewport: Carbon strip with breadcrumbs, category stamp, title and read time. Then the ruled column: takeaways as a boxed note at the top, body on the rules, the margin carrying share, a pinned service slip and progress; FAQ and sources as fine print; author sheet and related posts at the end.
options.risk: Margin furniture can crowd the text on mid-size screens; needs a strict reading measure.

regions.label: carbon strip: crumbs, title, read time

options.label: The Filed Memo
options.lineage: an internal memo filed in the pad
options.thesis: Every article opens as a memo: subject, date, who it is for, and the short answer, before the long explanation.
options.viewport: Paper page with a red double-ruled memo header (נושא / תאריך / למי / זמן קריאה), then the takeaways as the short answer in a boxed slip, then the ruled body; FAQ, sources, author and a closing slip.
options.risk: Memo framing suits how-to posts better than opinion pieces.

options.label: Guided Read
options.lineage: a long read with the pad's own index
options.thesis: A sticky contents list on the start side tracks where you are; the body reads wide and calm.
options.viewport: Carbon strip with title and read time; below, a sticky contents sheet (the article's headings) beside the ruled body, with a red progress rule along the top; takeaways open the body; FAQ, sources, author, related.
options.risk: Contents needs headings extracted from markdown; short posts gain little from it.
